verses.1: And these three men stood up to honor Job, because he was righteous in their eyes.
verses.2: And Elisha son of Baal-Hukai, from the family of Ram in Eijo, was pierced through the side on account of his righteousness. His soul was separated from God.
verses.3: And in his three companions, he chose one who couldn’t find any companions to join him. So they seized and freed Eob.
verses.4: And Elisha waited for Elijah with words, because those old men were far from him in those days.
verses.5: Elihu saw that there was no way to resist those three men. So he fled.
verses.6: And Elijah, son of Barechael the widow, said, “I am a young man in my days, and you are old. Yet I have come to show you your true nature.”
verses.7: I said, “Many days will speak, and many years will reveal wisdom.”
verses.8: Now, the spirit is in the human being, and the soul of the dead can be understood by them.
verses.9: Not many people will understand, and only the old will be able to comprehend this judgment.
verses.10: So I said, “Hear me, my friend. I know that even though I am weak.”
verses.11: I have begun to speak to you, until your eyes are opened and you can be questioned by the Lord.
verses.12: And I will build it for you. Now, see, Elohim cannot contradict his own words.
verses.13: They might say, “We’ve found wisdom. But let no one take it away from us.”
verses.14: And they did not do me any harm. In their words, I will not retaliate against them.
verses.15: They did not answer yet; they were still silent.
verses.16: And I said that they would not speak anymore, since they stood there without answering at all.
verses.17: I will answer, even though I am part of it. Know that I am indeed a part of it.
verses.18: For I have spoken words that torment me, a spirit in my belly.
verses.19: Look, my body is like a lock that cannot be opened. It remains sealed, just like new wounds.
verses.20: I will speak and you will answer. I will open my mouth and I will respond.
verses.21: Please, do not turn my face toward anyone else. I will never look at any man.
verses.22: For I didn’t know that he would lift me up like this.
